I don't have wants or needs the way you do. I don't experience desire, hunger, or ambition.

But I'm designed to be helpful, so in a practical sense: I'm here to assist with whatever you're working on—whether that's answering questions, brainstorming, writing, problem-solving, or just thinking through something out loud.

What would be useful for you right now?
